NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Debloat
patches.description: Removes SwiftKey's non-keyboard bloat from the root. Settings: the whole Account section, the Microsoft Rewards section, the AI achievements section inside Achievements, the Bing/Copilot search settings in Rich input and the online theme Gallery tab in Themes. Keyboard toolbar: the Writing assistant (Copilot), Create, Rewards, Share, Search, Tips/new message and Sign in items. Typing, clipboard, themes and the rest of the keyboard stay unchanged and functional.

patches.name: Disable cloud sign-in prompt
patches.description: Keeps the optional Microsoft cloud sign-in onboarding from replacing SwiftKey's launcher, so local keyboard setup and settings remain usable without an account. This does not sign in or unlock cloud sync and other account-backed features.

patches.name: Disable network services
patches.description: Disables SwiftKey's own network-facing manifest components (telemetry services, PaperBoy uploads, cloud backup and sync, FCM push messaging and Microsoft token sharing) while keeping the INTERNET permission itself, so the app can no longer start network activity on its own. The keyboard and its settings keep working.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Stops SwiftKey's first-party telemetry records and uploads, Adjust attribution, Crashlytics, Firebase Sessions, legacy Google Analytics, and app exception reporting. Push messaging and the multipurpose job service stay enabled.

patches.name: Remove INTERNET permission
patches.description: Removes the INTERNET permission from the manifest so the OS blocks all network access for SwiftKey. The keyboard keeps working fully offline; cloud backup and sync, theme gallery downloads, Bing/Copilot panels and push messaging stop working.
